news.title: Choice International Limited (BSE:531358) completed the acquisition of rema.ining 50% stake in Choice Insurance Broking India Private Limited
news.body:
Choice International Limited (BSE:531358) entered into an agreement to acquire remaining 50% stake in Choice Insurance Broking India Private Limited for approximately INR 630 million on June 18, 2025. A cash consideration valued at INR 947 per share will be paid by Choice International Limited for 660,000 shares.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, Choice Insurance Broking India Private Limited reported total revenue of INR 885.88 million. As of March 31, 2025, Choice Insurance Broking India Private Limited reported total common equity of INR 196.559 million.

The transaction is subject to approval by Insurance Regulatory & Development Authority. The expected completion of the transaction is 12 months from execution of agreement.

news.title: Choice International Limited (BSE:531358) completed the acquisition of 51% stake in Fintoo Wealth Private Limited.
news.body:
Choice International Limited (BSE:531358) entered into a Memorandum of Understanding to acquire 51% stake in Fintoo Wealth Private Limited for approximately INR 100 million on October 17, 2025. A cash consideration of INR 100 million will be paid by Choice International Limited. As part of consideration, INR 100 million is paid towards common equity of Fintoo Wealth Private Limited. In related transactions, Choice International Limited entered into definitive agreements to acquire distribution business of Mihika Financial Services Private Limited and Mihika Insurance Marketing Firm LLP. As of March 31, 2025, Fintoo Wealth had INR 2.5 million in revenue and INR 2.762 million in total common equity.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹3.09 (vs ₹1.54 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹3.09 (up from ₹1.54 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹2.87b (up 47% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹656.2m (up 114% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 23% (up from 16% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 27% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 16% growth forecast for the Capital Markets industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 38% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 81% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
